scientific_integrity: An explicit proof handles infinite frames by a Euclidean-cluster lemma and structural induction; finite enumeration is supporting evidence, not a substitute. Literature priority and proof have not been independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Parameter-free one-variable normal modal logic on arbitrary Euclidean Kripke frames; no extension to extra fixed parameters, other modal frame classes, or multiple modalities. Older equivalent K5 tabularity or free-algebra enumerations remain a literature risk.
title: Twelve normal additive unary modalities on Euclidean frames
